subject: Co-sell SKU visibility & consolidation for DataCloud Labs (GCP + Azure)
messages:
From: Sara Cho <sara.cho@datacloudlabs.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Jun 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Consolidating SKUs for co-sell visibility (GCP + Azure)

Hi Markus,

Thanks for taking this call last week — appreciate the quick intro. We're kicking off marketplace listing work for DataCloud Labs and want to avoid two separate, low-visibility listings on GCP and Azure. Our ask: can Redwood help consolidate the SKUs / entitlements so customers see a single "Sell-with" experience (and so co-sell tagging surfaces correctly) across both clouds?

Attached: sku_map.xlsx (current internal SKU map) and product_overview.pdf.

Top questions for the sync: 
- What evidence (telemetry, billing, PoC usage) do you need to qualify a unified co-sell SKU?
- Do you have a preferred schema for telemetry exports to support metering for co-sell reporting?
- Timeline: we're hoping to be listed and co-sell-ready by mid-July. Is that feasible?

Can we set a 30-min sync this week? I can do 10–12 PT on Thu or 8–10 PT on Fri.

Thanks,
Sara
Sara Cho
Head of Partnerships, DataCloud Labs
sara.cho@datacloudlabs.com
+1 415-555-0132

Attachments: sku_map.xlsx (spreadsheet), product_overview.pdf (pdf)

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Sara Cho <sara.cho@datacloudlabs.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Jun 2029 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Consolidating SKUs for co-sell visibility (GCP + Azure)

Sara — thanks for the note and the attachments. Happy to help streamline this. I'm looping in Olga (partner ops) for the evidence checklist and Ben (alliances) for GTM coordination.

Proposed 30-min agenda:
1) Quick mapping review (you walk us through sku_map.xlsx)
2) Evidence requirements we need for co-sell + marketplace listing (security, billing, telemetry)
3) Export/schema ask for telemetry + next steps & owners

I can do Thu 10:30 PT — does that work?

Immediate asks so we can come prepared:
- If there's already a pipeline or opportunity, share the deal id (helps prioritize).
- A sample invoice or billing export showing customer-facing SKU names (marketplace teams often ask for this).
- Any SOC2 / security attestation we can include in the listing.

From experience: the two biggest blockers are (a) mismatched SKU nomenclature between clouds, and (b) missing event-level telemetry to show usage for co-sell metrics. If you can confirm approximate monthly active customers or token/usage numbers in the Drive doc, that helps us recommend a metering path.

I'll book Thu 10:30 PT tentatively and send a calendar invite.

—Markus
Markus Klein
Head of Alliances (Marketplaces), Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.com

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Sara Cho <sara.cho@datacloudlabs.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 26 Jun 2029 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Consolidating SKUs for co-sell visibility (GCP + Azure)

Sara — quick checklist from partner ops so the listing & co-sell tag can be processed without rework:

Required evidence (minimum):
- SKU mapping (canonical name + cloud-specific SKU ids) — good start; we'll need a normalized CSV, not just the XLS view.
- Sample invoice or billing export showing those SKUs (PDF or CSV).
- SOC 2 Type II letter or equivalent compliance statement.
- Entitlement path doc (how customers are granted access; license keys or marketplace entitlement mapping).
- Listing screenshots and artifacts for each cloud (publisher consoles).

Optional / accelerators:
- Telemetry export (events with customer_id, sku_id, usage_amount, timestamp) — this lets us recommend a metering SKU and enable co-sell reporting.
- Joint press blurb or co-sell case study (for GTM visibility).

Internal deadlines: we're gating the co-sell push for our July 10 marketplace campaign. To hit that window we need final evidence by EOD July 2 so our catalog & metering teams have time to validate.

I've attached our marketplace_evidence_checklist.pdf — please fill the fields and share back. Also, Sara, if you can confirm whether DataCloud opts into telemetry exports (yes/no) that will determine whether we recommend native metering vs. trial-based co-sell.

— Olga
Olga Petrov
Principal Partner Ops, Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com

Attachments: marketplace_evidence_checklist.pdf

From: Sara Cho <sara.cho@datacloudlabs.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Ravi Singh <ravi.singh@aws-partner.com>
Date: Wed, 26 Jun 2029 13:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Consolidating SKUs for co-sell visibility (GCP + Azure)

Thanks, Markus and Olga — all good. Quick answers inline:
- Deal: yes, please prioritize — HubSpot HS-45592 (we've got a POC with a large retail customer; emailing the AE separately).
- Invoice: attaching sample-invoice.pdf and cosell_agreement_v1.docx (draft) for your review.
- SOC2: we have a SOC2 report that we can provide to partners under NDA.
- Telemetry: we can export events. Our engineering team uses an event schema; I added a shared Drive doc with the schema and example exports: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cdatacloud-share.

Per Olga's ask we'll fill the checklist and upload a normalized SKU CSV by EOD Thu. Ravi (cc'd) is our AWS partner rep; he can help validate the sell-with mapping on the AWS side — Ravi, can your team confirm whether a consolidated SKU (single entitlement) is compatible with the Sell With program?

We can meet Thu 10:30 PT — calendar invite accepted. Looking forward to next steps.

Best,
Sara

Attachments: cosell_agreement_v1.docx, sample-invoice.pdf

Subject: Re: Consolidating SKUs for co-sell visibility (GCP + Azure)

Thanks all — good progress. Quick summary / next steps so we have clear owners before the Thu sync: 

1) DataCloud (Sara) — upload normalized SKU CSV + filled marketplace_evidence_checklist.pdf by EOD Thu (6/27). Provide the SOC2 under NDA to partner-ops. Link to Drive is in related_links.
2) Redwood Partner Ops (Olga) — validate evidence on receipt and confirm whether a single consolidated entitlement can be rendered as a sell-with SKU across GCP/Azure; target confirmation by Mon 7/1.
3) Alliances/GTM (Ben / Markus) — confirm co-sell tagging and GTM cadence; if evidence is complete we'll include DataCloud in Redwood's July 10 marketplace push.
4) AWS (Ravi) — please confirm compatibility with AWS Sell With policy; advise if an additional registration is required.

I'll finalize the calendar invite for Thu 10:30 PT and include a short pre-read with the checklist and the attachments you've sent. If we get the evidence by the deadline we should be on track for the July 10 campaign.

—Markus
